name: PRReviewer
description: Review pull requests using AI-powered analysis with GitHub Copilot
author: pr-reviewer

inputs.name: copilotToken
inputs.label: Copilot Token
inputs.helpMarkDown: GitHub Personal Access Token with Copilot access. Store this in a pipeline secret variable.

inputs.name: configPath
inputs.label: Config Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to review configuration file. If not provided, will auto-discover pr-review.config.json, .pr-review.json, or .github/pr-review.json

inputs.name: postComment
inputs.label: Post Comment
inputs.helpMarkDown: Post review results as a PR comment

inputs.name: failOnError
inputs.label: Fail On Error
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the pipeline if errors are found in the review
